error.PASSKEY_FAILED: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with your password, or try another passkey.
error.PASSKEY_CHALLENGE_INVALID: The passkey request expired. Try again.
error.PASSKEY_REGISTRATION_FAILED: The passkey could not be verified. Try again, or use another device.
error.PASSKEY_LIMIT: You have the maximum number of passkeys. Remove one to add another.
error.PASSKEY_NAME_INVALID: Use a name of 1 to 100 characters.
error.PASSKEYS_UNAVAILABLE: Passkeys are not available on this server.
error.PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Your account has a temporary password. Sign in with it and choose your own password first.
error.REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: Enter your current password to add a passkey.
error.deviceRegistered: This device already has a passkey for your account.
error.cancelled: The passkey request was cancelled or timed out.
error.browserUnavailable: Passkeys are unavailable in this browser. Use your password instead.
title: Passkeys
intro: A passkey lets you sign in with this device's screen lock or a security key instead of typing your password. Your password keeps working either way.
added: Added “{name}”. You can now sign in with it or with your password.
unavailableServer: Passkeys are not available on this server's address.
unavailableBrowser: This browser cannot create passkeys here. Use your password.
name.label: Passkey name
name.hint: Helps you recognise it later, for example the device.
password.label: Current password
password.hint: Required because you signed in a while ago.
signInAgain: Sign out and sign in again, then add the passkey.
